AcademicRequirementsMetaData.subtitle: Entry Requirements
description: Graduate Diploma (Level 7): More than 60% and above in Graduation

AcademicRequirementsMetaData.subtitle: English Requirement
description: IELTS Academic: Minimum overall score of 6.5, with no band below 6.0
PTE Academic: Minimum overall score of 58, with no communicative skill below 50
TOEFL iBT (120 scale): Minimum overall score of 90, with a minimum Writing score of 21
TOEFL iBT (6-point scale): Minimum overall score of 4.5, with a minimum Writing score of 4.5

feesMetaData.subtitle: Initial Tuition Fee Deposit
description: International student enrolled in a full-year course or studying from outside New Zealand on a student visa, you are generally required to pay your full year's tuition fees upfront at the start of your first semester

scholarshipMetaData.subtitle: Scholarships
description: Applicant must: (a) be an international student; (b) have received a conditional or unconditional offer of admission to an eligible master's programme at the University of Auckland; and (c) have an Admissions GPE of at least 7.0.
Up to 25% of tuition fees for the first two semesters
